description_en: Obtains OSS resource configuration information, which will be used for subsequent OSS file upload operations
description_zh: 获取OSS资源配置信息，此配置信息将用于后续OSS文件上传操作
name: GetOSSInfoForUploadFile

parameters.description_en:
The business type. Default value: **fcMediaSms**.

When you create a signature or template and upload **More Materials**, the value is **fcMediaSms**.
parameters.description_zh:
业务类型，默认值为**fcMediaSms**。

创建签名、创建模板时，上传**更多资料**场景，该值为**fcMediaSms**。
